passage: Winter was coming to the forest. Every morning, frost sparkled on the grass, and the wind felt sharper. Ruby the fox knew she needed a warm place to sleep. She found a hole under the roots of an old oak tree and began to dig. She dug until the hole was deep and round, like a small room under the ground. Then she carried in dry leaves and soft moss to make a bed. That night, snow covered the forest. But inside her den, Ruby was snug and warm, dreaming of spring.
